author: Myv
body: When is the 1.8 update meant to come out? It was due in June, so it is very overdue.

title: 1.8 Update

replies.author: Emmaye
replies.body: I have no idea, I am guessing they will release it near Minecon 2014. Whenever I went to Minecon 2013, a few days before that they released 1.7, and then at the panels they had a lot of new things to discuss about in the update and future plans with 1.8 and many other versions with future plans. If this does so happen it must be a big update, pretty much 1 year since the last major update!
